content: SCD Type 2 / effective-dated pattern for salary history: never overwrite, insert new row per change with effective_start_date, effective_end_date (nullable/far-future for current), and a surrogate PK distinct from natural key (user_id). Enables point-in-time queries (what was salary on date X) needed for both YTD tax accumulation and 12-month vacation averaging. Consistently described across 10 independent sources (data warehousing standard pattern).
